entry.author: Antarctica New Zealand
entry.summary:
Dave Langrish at New Zealand's Scott Base has gone the extra mile—literally and figuratively—by raising funds for Canteen, a charity supporting young people impacted by cancer in New Zealand. What makes this effort even more impressive? Dave had never really planked before taking on this challenge! 

Dave started a Give Little (NZ) page in October for his 'Antarctic Plank Challenge' with a target of planking for 20 minutes. By 9 December, he had pushed that out to 1 hour and six minutes.

His efforts were even featured on Wednesday 10 December on TVNZ's Seven Sharp, shining a spotlight on the incredible things that can happen when purpose meets perseverance.

Dave’s role at Scott Base is ‘field support’ his team provides practical support to scientists and others working in the field. They keep us all alive in one of the most extreme environments on the planet!

You can give a shout out to the man with a heart of gold and abs of steel by donating here:  
https://givealittle.co.nz/fundraiser/antarctic-plank-challenge?ref=home&ref_code=donation_feed

The challenge closes on 23 December.
